## PUSHED — Gerrit change 1288

Squashed to ONE commit (a RED-only commit can never earn `Verified +1`), rebased onto current
`gerrit/main`, and the diff verified against `gerrit/main` as exactly the intended 4 files / 667
insertions — checked because an earlier agent's `git reset --soft gerrit/main` once swept in other
people's landed commits and nearly pushed a partial revert. I reset to the explicit base SHA
`de2f1ed87` instead of to the moving `gerrit/main` for that reason.

Gates before push: `make lint` clean, `make typecheck` clean (416 files), `scripts/check_config_reads.py`
OK, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/` **287 passed**. Change-Id present. Pushed after a FULL
`git fetch gerrit` (avoids the `Missing tree` thin-pack error that cost an earlier agent two pushes).

Awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`. Its live cell may legitimately end at `SETUP FAILED` rather
than green — harness run 30784592232 established that **Data Center REFUSES to null a sub-task's
`fields.parent`** (HTTP 400 `{"errors":{"parent":"data was not an object"}}`). That is the platform
branch this ticket's AC already anticipates; it is not this fix failing.
